annotation.title_clean: Montenegro - International Bar Association (IBA ANLBS AI Working Group Report, Montenegro chapter)
annotation.title_en: Montenegro - International Bar Association (IBA ANLBS AI Working Group Report, Montenegro chapter)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Sladaković, N.; Tutić, B. (Gecic Law); IBA Alternative and New Law Business Structures Committee
annotation.summary_en: Montenegro country chapter of an IBA questionnaire-based report on AI in legal services. It finds no formal AI definition or dedicated AI law, early-stage use of legal AI tools, no relevant case law, and expected alignment with the EU AI Act via the Stabilisation and Association Agreement. Bar bodies are urged to train members and issue guidelines.
key_provisions_or_claims: Montenegro has no formal definition of AI and no dedicated AI legislation.
Alignment with the EU AI Act is expected through the Stabilisation and Association Agreement.
Existing laws (Constitution, Personal Data Protection Act, Convention 108) apply to AI.
Legal AI use is early-stage and concentrated in larger and international firms.
Professional bodies should train members, issue guidelines, monitor compliance and advocate for regulation.
